name: [FIXED] Soul War
desc:
The game has now ended development, meaning no more updates will take place. Thank you all for the support

📜 Complete quests to level up and get stronger. Leveling up grants skill points to unlock new abilities and bonuses on the skill tree. Access inventory in the menu (M) to equip new skills.

🎮 Controls: 
[M] - Menu
[`] - Skill / Accessory Inventory
[Double tap W] - Sprint
[Q] - Flashtep / Dash
[LMB] - Light Attack
[RMB] - Heavy Attack
[F] - Block
[F] + Left Mouse Button - Parry
[V] - Primary Transformation
[B] - Secondary Transformation
[N] - Meditate

⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates, also join the group for future perks!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/8357001/Soul-War-MAIN-GROUP#!/about
